platform: Infleqtion Sqale cesium neutral-atom gate set
purpose: Replace the homogeneous p/q/p_loss abstraction with operation-typed channels without inventing unsupported rates.

derivation.candidate_data_basis_rotations: 26 H plus 12 S/Sdag macros = 38 abstract Clifford rotations
derivation.parity_chain_identity: For each of 10 parity checks, product_j CNOT(control_j -> syndrome) = H_syndrome [product_j CZ(control_j,syndrome)] H_syndrome, so 39 CNOT-like interactions compile to 39 CZ requests plus 20 syndrome-H macros rather than 78 H macros.
derivation.flag_basis: 4 flag |+> preparations and 4 X-basis flag measurements add 8 H macros.

CZ_equivalent.source_channel: CZ phase plus five-level leakage/loss model; public fidelity summaries available
CZ_equivalent.note: Error propagation after compilation must use the compiled CZ+1Q circuit, not reuse CNOT Pauli propagation silently.

direct_local_Rz_S_macro.source_channel: Rz relative coherent angle error and leakage model

local_H_macro.native_family: compiled from global GR(theta,phi) plus local Rz sandwiches
local_H_macro.reason: Sqale's published native gate set has global XY rotations and single-site Rz. A local H is not assigned one GR count without an explicit spectator-refocusing schedule.
local_H_macro.requirement: compiled pulse/gate list must provide exact GR and Rz multiplicities and spectator action before hardware-facing scoring

prep_reset_macro.open: repeated mid-circuit reset channel for reused syndrome/flag ancillas

NDSSR_binary_measurement.channel: epsilon_1to0 and epsilon_0to1 plus readout-associated atom loss

data_idle_site_epoch.native_family: idle/storage plus any motion/retiming inserted by compiler
data_idle_site_epoch.requirement: duration-resolved dephasing/leakage/loss channel and compiled schedule times

source_profile_2025_logical_experiment.provenance: Chung et al., npj Quantum Information 11, 193 (2025), DOI 10.1038/s41534-025-01095-w

state_preparation.typed_note: source variables renamed here to avoid collision with MQM p/q

CZ.typed_note: 0.0052 is not a uniform two-qubit Pauli probability

GR.typed_note: coherent rotation error, not Bernoulli Pauli

Rz.typed_note: coherent relative angle error plus state-dependent leakage

source_profile_2025_PRX_characterization.provenance: Radnaev et al., PRX Quantum 6, 030334 (2025), DOI 10.1103/66s8-jj18
source_profile_2025_PRX_characterization.typed_note: This is a different characterized operating point from the 2025 logical-experiment noise model; do not combine values silently.

ell_Rz_leakage_from_1.note: leakage, not necessarily physical atom loss

must_close: exact compiler-expanded GR/Rz counts for all local_H macros including spectator echoes
typed motion-associated error/loss if atom motion is inserted
same-operating-point CZ loss/leakage channel for the target backend
measurement-state population model for asymmetric epsilon_1to0/epsilon_0to1
forbidden: replace all typed channels by one p
average asymmetric measurement errors without a frozen state distribution
copy readout loss to every idle/loss epoch
reuse postselected CZ infidelity as a Pauli rate
